Why go: Koh Samui's new art park, by day and by night

The Xperience is an immersive art and theme park on the jungle hillside above Lipa Noi, on Koh Samui's west coast. It opened in early 2026 and nothing else on the island looks like it: 12 themed zones with more than 100 artworks, giant hyper-realistic sculptures, a white-sand beach club around a heart-shaped lagoon, an infinity pool at the Sky Bar, a maze of 30 light installations and a wellness village. After sunset the park changes completely: the trees and spires light up, the giant figures come alive with projection mapping, and the fire performers start.

The Day Pass is valid for the whole day you choose, from 11:00 until closing at 22:00, or midnight on Fridays. It includes every public zone, the lagoon and pools, the workshops and live events of the day, and the evening light and fire shows. We sell it at the park's own price of 1,500 THB, with secure card payment in Thai baht.

Family Days: children and teens under 16 can visit on Thursday, Saturday and Sunday only. Wednesday and Friday are 16+. Children 0–2 enter free; from age 3 they pay the full Day Pass price.

How booking works

  1. 1 Choose your date (Wednesday to Sunday) and the number of guests, then pay by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay.
  2. 2 We book your entry with the park in your name for that day.
  3. 3 We email your entry confirmation; if anything needs checking, we message you on WhatsApp.
  4. 4 On the day, show your confirmation at the entrance in Lipa Noi.

Online booking for tomorrow closes at midnight Thailand time. Food, drinks, VIP areas, wellness sessions and transport are not included.

Who it's for

Couples, groups of friends, photographers and content creators, families with children on a Family Day, and anyone looking for a full afternoon and evening out, or a plan for a day when the sea is too rough for boats. If you only have an hour, or you're looking for a cheap beach day, it isn't good value: the night show is the highlight.

Best way to do it

Arrive around 15:00. Take a golf cart to the top, walk down through the zones while it's light, swim at The Playa, stay for sunset (about 17:55 in November) and then the light show and fire show. Allow 5–6 hours. Bring swimwear, sunscreen, comfortable shoes and mosquito repellent. Outside food and drink, pets, drugs and nudity are not allowed.

Getting there

The park is about 5 minutes from Nikki Beach, 10–15 minutes from Nathon and 40–50 minutes from Chaweng. Taxis and Grab are scarce on the west coast after dark, so the easiest way to stay for the night show is our private van with driver (8 hours, 4,500 THB for up to 10 people), whose driver waits and takes you home. Everything about the park, from the zones to food prices, is in our guide to The Xperience.
